title: Makeup air required.
officialText:
Exhaust hood systems capable of exhausting in excess of 400 cfm (0.19 m3/s) shall be provided with
makeup air at a rate in accordance with Table 403.3. Such makeup air systems shall be equipped with a means of closure and shall be
automatically controlled to start and operate simultaneously with the exhaust system.
SECTION MC 506
COMMERCIAL KITCHEN HOOD VENTILATION
SYSTEM DUCTS AND EXHAUST EQUIPMENT
